# NovaMac Solutions — High-Performance Software & Digital Studio
> NovaMac Solutions builds custom Next.js web applications, UI/UX design systems, AI CRMs, and headless e-commerce platforms engineered for sub-second speeds.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Custom Web Development: High-speed Next.js / React platforms built from scratch with 100% source code ownership. (Starting from $499)
- Custom E-Commerce: Headless storefronts, Shopify Storefront API, and WooCommerce custom builds optimized for high conversion. (Starting from $799)
- AI Automation & Autonomous Agents: Custom LLM integrations, RAG systems, and AI customer agents connected to business data. (Starting from $499)
- CRM & Business Automation: Bespoke internal platforms replacing spreadsheets with automated lead pipelines and role-based dashboards. (Starting from $599)
- Graphic Design & Brand Identity: High-impact vector logos, brand guidelines, and commercial visual identity packs. (Starting from $149)
- B2B Lead Generation & Sales Funnels: Automated lead capture engines, cold outreach systems, and high-converting landing pages. (Starting from $249/mo)
- Mobile App Development: Cross-platform iOS and Android applications with native performance. (Starting from $899)
- Performance Marketing & SEO: Data-driven technical SEO, paid acquisition, and conversion rate optimization. (Starting from $199/mo)
